items.title: “Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising-” Anime Set To Be Released January 2027 In U.S. Theaters
items.text:
Aniplex of America and Fathom Entertainment announced at their New York Comic Con 2026 panel that the highly-anticipated film “Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht Rising-” will be released in January 2027 in U.S. theaters. The film will be available nationwide January 16-19, 2027 with the option of English subtitles with Japanese audio or the English dubbed version.

 “Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht Rising-” is the fourth film in the “Madoka Magica” franchise and is the sequel to the 2013 film, “Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie -Rebellion-”. The film was originally set to be released Winter 2024 but was delayed twice. The film was finally released on August 28, 2026 in theaters in Japan and was # 1 opening weekend earning about $5.95 million USD in the first three days.

 Aniplex of America also revealed during the panel that it will release the previous films, “Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie Part 1: Beginnings”, “Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie Part 2: Eternal”, and “Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie Part 3: Rebellion”, in a Ultra HD Blu-ray Disc box set with Dolby Atmos audio. The box set will be available on October 15, 2026 on the Crunchyroll Store and MediaOCD store. 

 In addition, the three films will begin streaming on Crunchyroll on November 8, 2026 and on Netflix on January 2, 2027. The movies will also add Spanish and Portuguese dubbing on Crunchyroll on November 15, 2026.

 The cast and staff from “Rebellion” returned for the new film with the animated studio SHAFT and original creators Magica Quartet. Yukihiro Miyamoto directed the film with Akiyuki Shimbo as the chief director. Gen Urobuchi from Nitroplus wrote the script and Yuki Kajiura composed the film. Ume Aoki handled the original character designer with Junichiro Taniguchi as the animation character designer. Gekidan Inu Curry returned as the parallel world designer to design the Witches Spaces.

 The returning cast includes: Aoi Yuki as “Madoka Kaname”, Chiwa Saito as “Homura Akemi”, Kaori Mizuhashi as “Mami Tomoe”, Eri Kitamura as “Sayaka Miki”, Ai Nonaka as “Kyoko Sakura”, Kana Asumi as “Nagisa Momoe”, and Emiri Kato as “Kyubey”.

 The original 12-episode TV anime “Puella Magi Madoka Magica” was released in 2011 and can currently be streamed on Crunchyroll and Netflix in subtitles and English dubbing.
 “Puella Magi Madoka Magica” Synopsis: She has a loving family and best friends, laughs and cries from time to time… Madoka Kaname, an eighth grader of Mitakihara middle school, is one of those who lives such a life. One day, she had a very magical encounter. She doesn't know if it happened by chance or by fate yet. This is a fateful encounter that can change her destiny. This is a beginning of the new story of the magical witch girls.

 The “Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie Part 1: Beginnings” and “Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie Part 2: Eternal” compilation films were released in theaters in Japan in October 2012. The sequel film, “Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie Part 3: Rebellion”, was released in theaters in Japan in October 2013.

 In 2020, the spin-off TV anime series “Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story” was released. Season 2 was released in July 2021 and Season 3 in April 2022. “Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story” is available to stream on Crunchyroll in subtitles.
 “Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story” Synopsis: In exchange for the fulfillment of a wish, Magical Girls keep fighting, unbeknownst to the rest of the world. But Iroha Tamaki can’t seem to remember her wish. "When I became a Magical Girl, what did I wish for again?" There is a gaping hole in her life. Something important has been lost. But she continues to fight every day, without even knowing why… Then, a rumor begins to spread among Magical Girls. "Magical Girls can be saved if they go to Kamihama." Kamihama City, the city where Magical Girls and Uwasa are gathering. The story of Iroha Tamaki, in search of her lost wish, begins…

 “Puella Magi Madoka Magica” manga is currently being published by Yen Press in English in the US.

items.title: “The Moon on a Rainy Night” TV Anime Releases 1st Trailer
items.text:
The official website for “The Moon on a Rainy Night” released the first trailer for the upcoming Yuri TV anime. The Girls Love anime is set to premiere in 2027. 

 According to REMOW, “the trailer features Closed Caption subtitles in 17 languages, including dialogue, sound effects, and music, so fans around the world can fully experience ‘The Moon on a Rainy Night’”. In addition, the main website announced the main cast members for the series. The cast members include Iori Saeki as “Saki Kindaichi” and Sora Amamiya as “Kanon Oikawa”.

 The TV anime is being produced by CompTown with Tomoe Makino directing, and Shōgo Yasukawa writing and overseeing the series scripts. The character design will be handled by Ayumi Nishibata with Haruko Nobori as the color key artist. Mai Ichioka will serve as the art director with Atsushi Satō as the compositing director of photography, and Masahiro Gotō as the editor. Sound direction will be handled by Nobuyuki Abe with jizue as the musical composer. 

 “The Moon on a Rainy Night” is based on the manga by artist and creator Kuzushiro. The on-going manga was first launched on Kodansha's Comic Days website in June 2021 and currently had 12 volumes on print in Japan. Kuzushiro is best known for creating the manga “Living With My Brother's Wife” and “A Mangaka's Weirdly Wonderful Workplace” (Egao no Taenai Shokuba desu). “The Moon on a Rainy Night” anime was initially announced in November 2024 by Kodansha USA. In August 2026, REMOW announced at their Anime NYC panel that the anime was set to be released in 2027. 

 Kodansha USA is publishing “The Moon on a Rainy Night” in English in print and digitally. There are currently 8 volumes released. Volume 9 is set to be released on January 19, 2027.

items.text:
Crunchyroll announced at their Anime Expo 2026 Showcase panel that the Yuri TV anime “The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn’t a Guy at All” is set to premiere in January 2027. Crunchyroll will simulcast the Girls Love anime as it airs in Japan as part of their Winter 2027 Anime Season.

 “The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn’t a Guy at All” anime will star Mariya Ise as ‘Mitsuki Koga’ and Akari Kito ‘Aya Osawa’. Masashi Ishihama will direct the series at CloverWorks. Rino Yamasaki will handle series composition and Kanna Hirayama is handling the character designs. “Breed” by Nirvana will be the opening theme song for the series.

 The anime is based on the manga by Sumiko Arai, which was first posted on X in 2022 and later serialized online on Pixiv Comic and released in print by Kadokawa Shoten in April 2023. A Drama adaptation was released released in April 2024, starring Akari Kito as Aya and Mariya Ise as Mitsuki. Yen Press currently publishes the English version with Volume 4 set to be released on October 27, 2026.

 Yen Press Synopsis: Fashionable and upbeat high schooler Aya loves listening to rock, but no one else seems to share her interest…until she meets a cool, stylish employee at a CD shop. Dressed in black from head to toe, he has this air of mystery about him, and his taste in music is impeccable. Aya falls hard for him—not knowing her crush is actually her female classmate Mitsuki! For her part, Mitsuki generally keeps to herself and avoids standing out at school. But given that she sits right next to Aya, Mitsuki’s all too aware of the other girl’s feelings, and she’s afraid to reveal the truth. So why does she find herself talking with Aya more and more…?

items.text:
The official website for “Young Ladies Don't Play Fighting Games” announced that the Yuri TV anime is set to premiere on July 7, 2026. Crunchyroll will simulcast the Girls Love anime as it airs in Japan as part of their Summer 2026 Anime Season.

 Based on the manga by Eri Ejima, “Young Ladies Don't Play Fighting Games” (Tai Ari Deshita: Ojō-sama wa Kakutō Game Nante Shinai) anime stars Ikumi Hasegawa as ‘Aya Mitsuki’ and Kana Ichinose as ‘Mio Yorue’. Shota Ihata is directing the anime at Diomedéa with Kana Hashiguchi drawing the character designs. Wataru Watari is handling the series composition and Kana Hashiguchi composing the music. “Young Ladies Don't Play Fighting Games” was originally set to premiere in 2025, but the production committee decided to delay the release. 

 The series will feature a collaboration with the video game “Street Fighter 6” and footage will be used as the main game for the series. The “Young Ladies Don't Play Fighting Games” manga was first serialized by Comic Flapper in 2020 in Japan. The manga currently has 10 volumes. 

 Publisher Seven Seas is releasing the manga in English. Volume 10 is set to be released December 22, 2026.
 Synopsis: Kuromi Girls’ Academy is a refined, elegant school that expects the very best in deportment from its young ladies. Aya got into this peerless rich-girls’ institution on a scholarship, and hopes to grow as lovely as her fellow student and idol Shirayui. But Shirayui hides a terrible secret: she’s a trash-talking, combo-chaining, newbie-stomping, ruthless hardcore gamer! Could a mutual indulgence in no-holds-barred video game combat grow into a deeper rapport between these two girls?

items.title: "This Monster Wants to Eat Me" TV Anime Set To Premiere 2025
items.text:
The official website for “This Monster Wants to Eat Me” announced that the Yuri TV anime is set to premiere in 2025.

 The website also revealed the main cast and staff. The drama anime will star Reina Ueda as “Hinako Yaotose”. Naoyuki Kazuya is the chief director with Yusuke Suzuki as director at Studio Lings. Nozomi Ikuyama will handle the character design. The screenplay was written by Mitsutaka Hirota. Ryosuke Naya is the sound director with Keiji Inai in charge of the music. infinite is producing the anime. 

 Website Synopsis: "I've come to eat you," so softly utters the mermaid Shiori as she emerges from the sea and takes high school girl Hinako by the hand. Hinako lives alone in a town by the sea and possesses an unusually delicious body that is irresistible to nearby monsters. To ensure that she matures to the best condition, Shiori seeks to protect Hinako—all so that someday, she can devour every piece of her. A longing thought comes to Hinako's mind; "Maybe this monster can make my wish come true."

 “This Monster Wants to Eat Me” is adaptation of the manga written and illustrated by Sai Naekawa. The manga was first serialized in Kadokawa's Dengeki Maoh magazine in 2020. Naekawa celebrated the announcement of the anime with a special illustration (pictured below). The manga currently has 9 volumes in print in Japan. 

 Publisher Yen Press is releasing the manga in English. Volume 3 is set to be released on January 21, 2025. 
 Yen Press Synopsis: Hinako, a high school student with a dark past, lives alone in a town by the sea. Haunted by a constant sensation of drowning, she can barely go through the motions of her tedious life…until the day a monster tries to eat her! After passing out in the struggle, she awakens to find she’s been rescued by a beautiful mermaid. However, salvation comes at a cost—the mermaid’s protection will last only until Hinako has matured into the perfect meal! Hinako’s first instinct isn’t to run or scream, though, and an unlikely relationship between monster and prey unfolds… “I’ve come to devour you."

items.title: Original Anime “Narenare -Cheer for You!-” Set To Stream On Crunchyroll
items.text:
Crunchyroll announced that they have acquired exclusive rights to the upcoming original anime “Narenare -Cheer for You!-”. The streamer will simulcast the anime as it airs in Japan as part of their Summer 2024 Anime Season. The series is set to be released on July 7, 2024.

 Known in Japan as “Nanare Hananare”, the original anime follows the daily adventures of six girls.
 Crunchyroll Synopsis: Misora Kanata is a first-year student on the Takanosaki High School cheerleading team. She won a national championship in middle school, but can’t jump after a mistake in a competition. She befriends Suzuha, Shion, Anna, Onka, and Megumi to form the PoMPoMs. Their new team goes beyond cheerleading to reach the hearts of the people they cheer on. They might just change the world!

 The main cast includes: 
 Rika Nakagawa as “Kanata Misora” voiced by a bright & energetic girl who loves cheerleading. Tends to be unlucky but with great athleticism, won the national championship in jr. high and now aims to win in high school. 

 Yuki Nakashima as “Suzuha Obunai”, an expressionless, quiet and ultra-rational girl. She unwillingly catches attention on SNS for her parkour to commute to school. By contrast, she also has a clumsy side.

 Takeda Rarisatago as “Anna Aveiro”, a half-Brazilian / half-Japanese girl who practices capoeira and loves music. She is clearly assertive and does not hesitate to say what she thinks, and a great motivator of the team.

 Manaka Iwami as “Nodoka Ohtani”, a girl who loves yoga & philosophy. Her motto is "peace and tranquility" but she's always tossed around by Anna. She can be delusional with a slightest incident. 

 Moe Kahara as “Shion Tanazaki”, a tall girl who performs rhythmic gymnastics and is known as the "Fairy of Numata". She is sincere, humble, and diligent, and her kind personality has created a devoted fan base.

 Miku Ito as “Megumi Kaionji”, a former cheerleading club captain recovering from illness. Has a strong sense of responsibility and takes good care of Kanata. She's good at planing practice menu and performances.

 “Narenare -Cheer for You!-” is being written and directed by Koudai Kakimoto at P.A. Works. Takada Tomomi is providing the original character designs, while Kanami Sakeguchi is handling the character designs and chief animation direction. The music will be handled by Naoki Tani. P.A. Works and DMM.com are credited as producers.

items.title: Yuri Anime “Whisper Me a Love Song” To Stream On HIDIVE
items.text:
HIDIVE announced that they have acquired exclusive rights to the upcoming Yuri anime “Whisper Me a Love Song”. The streamer will simulcast the anime as it airs in Japan as part of their Spring 2024 Anime Season. The series is set to be released on April 13, 2024.

 Based on the manga by Eku Takeshima, “Whisper Me a Love Song” (Sasayaku You ni Koi wo Utau), the anime stars Hana Shimano as “Himari Kino” and Asami Seto as “Yori Asanagi”. Additional cast and characters include Mikako Komatsu as “Aki Mizuguchi”, Konomi Kohara as “Mari Tsutsui”, Ai Kakuma as “Kaori Tachibana”, Yuna Nemoto as “Shiho Izumi”, Reina Ueda as “Momoka Satomiya”, Chika Anzai as “Hajime Amasawa” and Aoi Koga as “Miki Mizuguchi”. The songs will be performed by artists Kana Sasakura (Yori Asanagi) and Sui Mizukami (Shiho Izumi). The anime's opening theme song "Follow your arrows" will be performed by the anime's band SSGIRLS with Kana Sasakura on vocals and Hana Shimano is performing the ending theme "Gifty".

 HIDIVE “Whisper Me a Love Song” Synopsis: After performing a song at her school’s opening ceremony, musician Yori Asanagi receives an apparent love confession from freshman Himari Kino. But just as Yori decides she wants to return Himari’s feelings, Himari reveals that she did not “love” her, but “admires” her! But you can’t unring a bell once struck, and Yori is determined to make Himari fall for her, not just her music. Will their hearts ever beat as one, or will their love fall out of tune?

 In December 2023, it was announced that the anime would be delayed from January 2024 to April 2024. According to the official website, the anime was delayed “due to various circumstances” and the director was changed “due to health reasons”. Akira Mano replaced Xin Ya Cai as the anime's director. Yokohama Animation Lab is now credited with production of the animation with Cloud Hearts. Hiroki Uchida is overseeing the series scripts, and Minami Yoshida is designing the characters. The art design is being handled by Risa Iraha with Sōshi Kuwashima as art director. The CG director is Keiichi Eda with Takahiro Kita as compositing director of photography. Sound direction is being handled by Fumiyuki Go and Nozomi Nakatani with music by Hiroshi Sasaki and Wataru Maeguchi.

 Manga artist Eku Takeshima launched the manga in Ichijinsha's iconic Comic Yuri Hime magazine in 2019. The on-going series currently has 9 volumes. According to the publisher, the manga has 500,000 copies in circulation.

 Kodansha USA is publishing the manga in English in print and digitally. There are currently 8 volumes released. Volume 8 was released on March 26, 2024.

 Kodansha’s “Whisper Me A Love Song” Synopsis: Bubbly, energetic first-year high school student Himari falls head over heels for her senpai Yori after hearing her band perform on the first day of school. Himari tells Yori she just loves her, and, to Himari’s surprise, Yori says she loves Himari back! But when Himari realizes that she and her senpai are feeling two different kinds of love, she begins to ask herself what “love” really means…

items.title: Yuri Anime “Whisper Me A Love Song” Announces Additional Cast
items.text:
The official website for the “Whisper Me A Love Song” Yuri TV anime announced additional cast members for the upcoming musical series. The romance anime is set to premiere in April 2024.

 The 3 new cast members include Reina Ueda as “Momoka Satomiya”, Chika Anzai as “Hajime Amasawa” and Aoi Koga as “Miki Mizuguchi”.

 Based on the manga by Eku Takeshima, “Whisper Me a Love Song” (Sasayaku You ni Koi wo Utau), the anime stars Hana Shimano as “Himari Kino” and Asami Seto as “Yori Asanagi”. Additional cast and characters include Mikako Komatsu as “Aki Mizuguchi”, Konomi Kohara as “Mari Tsutsui” Ai Kakuma as “Kaori Tachibana” and Yuna Nemoto as “Shiho Izumi”. The songs will be performed by artists Kana Sasakura (Yori Asanagi) and Sui Mizukami (Shiho Izumi).

 In December 2023, it was announced that the anime would be delayed from January 2024 to April 2024. According to the official website, the anime was delayed “due to various circumstances” and the director was changed “due to health reasons”. Akira Mano replaced Xin Ya Cai as the anime's director. Yokohama Animation Lab is now credited with production of the animation with Cloud Hearts. Hiroki Uchida is overseeing the series scripts, and Minami Yoshida is designing the characters. The art design is being handled by Risa Iraha with Sōshi Kuwashima as art director. The CG director is Keiichi Eda with Takahiro Kita as compositing director of photography. Sound direction is being handled by Fumiyuki Go and Nozomi Nakatani with music by Hiroshi Sasaki and Wataru Maeguchi.

 Manga artist Eku Takeshima launched the manga in Ichijinsha's iconic Comic Yuri Hime magazine in 2019. The on-going series currently has 8 volumes. According to the publisher, the manga has 500,000 copies in circulation.

 Kodansha USA is publishing the manga in English in print and digitally. There are currently 7 volumes released. Volume 8 is set to be released March 26, 2024.

 Kodansha’s “Whisper Me A Love Song” Synopsis: Bubbly, energetic first-year high school student Himari falls head over heels for her senpai Yori after hearing her band perform on the first day of school. Himari tells Yori she just loves her, and, to Himari’s surprise, Yori says she loves Himari back! But when Himari realizes that she and her senpai are feeling two different kinds of love, she begins to ask herself what “love” really means…

 “Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht Rising-” is the fourth film in the “Madoka Magica” franchise and is the sequel to the 2013 film, “Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie -Rebellion-”. The trailer (below) was released with the tagline, "And so, let the curtain rise on tonight's dream."

 The cast and staff from “Rebellion” will be returning for the new film with the animated studio SHAFT and original creators Magica Quartet. Yukihiro Miyamoto is directing the film with Akiyuki Shimbo as the chief director. Gen Urobuchi from Nitroplus will be writing the script and Yuki Kajiura will compose the film. aokiume is the original character designer with Junichiro Taniguchi as the animation character designer. Gekidan Inu Curry is returning as the parallel world designer to design the Witches Spaces.

 The returning cast includes: Aoi Yuki as “Madoka Kaname”, Chiwa Saito as “Homura Akemi”, Kaori Mizuhashi as “Mami Tomoe”, Eri Kitamura as “Sayaka Miki”, Ai Nonaka as “Kyoko Sakura”, Kana Asumi as “Nagisa Momoe”, and Emiri Kato as “Kyubey”.

 The original 12-episode TV anime “Puella Magi Madoka Magica” was released in 2011 and can currently be streamed on Crunchyroll and Netflix in subtitles and English dubbing. 
 “Puella Magi Madoka Magica” Synopsis: She has a loving family and best friends, laughs and cries from time to time… Madoka Kaname, an eighth grader of Mitakihara middle school, is one of those who lives such a life. One day, she had a very magical encounter. She doesn't know if it happened by chance or by fate yet. This is a fateful encounter that can change her destiny. This is a beginning of the new story of the magical witch girls.

 The “Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie Part 1: Beginnings” and “Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie Part 2: Eternal” compilation films were released in theaters in Japan in October 2012. The sequel film, “Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie Part 3: Rebellion”, was released in theaters in Japan in October 2013.

 In 2020, the spin-off TV anime series “Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story” was released. Season 2 was released in July 2021 and Season 3 in April 2022. “Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story” is available to stream on Crunchyroll and HIDIVE in subtitles.
 “Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story” Synopsis: In exchange for the fulfillment of a wish, Magical Girls keep fighting, unbeknownst to the rest of the world. But Iroha Tamaki can’t seem to remember her wish. "When I became a Magical Girl, what did I wish for again?" There is a gaping hole in her life. Something important has been lost. But she continues to fight every day, without even knowing why… Then, a rumor begins to spread among Magical Girls. "Magical Girls can be saved if they go to Kamihama." Kamihama City, the city where Magical Girls and Uwasa are gathering. The story of Iroha Tamaki, in search of her lost wish, begins…

items.text:
The official website for “The Vexations of a Shut-In Vampire Princess” announced the premiere date with a new trailer and key visual for the upcoming Yuri TV anime. The fantasy series is set to premiere on October 7, 2023.

 The new trailer (below) previews the opening theme song "Red Liberation" by fripSide. MIMiNARI will perform the ending theme song "Nemurenai feat. Kusunoki Tomori."

 In addition, the official website announced additional cast and characters including: 
 Sora Amamiya as “Millicent Bluenight”, 

 Reina Ueda as “Melca Tiano”, 

 and Saku Mizuno as “Tio Flat”.

 The anime stars Tomori Kusunoki as “Terakomari Gandesblood”, Sayumi Suzushiro as “Villhaze”, Yōko Hikasa as “Karen Helvetius”, Manaka Iwami as “Sakuna Memoir”, Fairouz Ai as “Nelia Cunningham”, and Miyuri Shimabukuro as “Karla Amatsu”.

 Based on the light novel by Kotei Kobayashi, “The Vexations of a Shut-In Vampire Princess” (Hikikomari Kyuuketsuki no Monmon) is being directed by Tatsuma Minamikawa at project No.9. Keiichirō Ōchi is handling series composition with Tomoyuki Shitaya designing the characters. Gō Shiina is composing the music.

 Author Kotei Kobayashi published the first light novel with illustrations by Riichu in January 2020 with publisher GA Bunko. The on-going series has 11 volumes in print in Japan. Original artist Riichu launched a manga adaptation in Square Enix's Big Gangan magazine in December 2021. The manga currently has 2 volumes in print.

 “The Vexations of a Shut-In Vampire Princess” light novels are currently being published in English by Yen Press. Volume 5 is set to be released on September 19, 2023. The manga adaptation has not been licensed in English as of yet.

 Yen Press “The Vexations of a Shut-In Vampire Princess” Synopsis: Three years into her life as a shut-in, vampire Terakomari Gandesblood (Komari for short), awakens to find she’s been appointed as a Commander in the Mulnite Imperial Army! The thing is, her new unit consists solely of belligerent ruffians who revolt against their superiors at the slightest hint of weakness. Although Komari hails from a line of vampires as powerful as they are prestigious, her refusal to drink blood has made her the picture of mediocrity—scrawny, un-coordinated, and inept at magic. With the odds stacked against her, will the help of her trusty (and slightly infatuated) maid Vill be enough for this recluse to blunder her way to success? Or will Komari rue the day she ever left the safety of her room?

The protagonist, Momo, lives a repressed life but still wishes to coexist with the enemy, the vampires. Fine, the vampire queen, once loved humans and disappeared from the battlefield. As war rages through the humans’ town, the two have a fateful encounter. 
 Once upon a time, humans and vampires lived in harmony in a place called Paradise. This is the story of a young girl and a vampire on a journey to find Paradise.

items.title: Top 10 Anime Of The Year 2021
items.text:
What a year it has been! A wide variety of great anime was released this year, and we honestly had a hard time narrowing down our list to ten. 
 Some honorable mentions, “Otherside Picnic” , “Laid-Back Camp Season 2” , “Mieruko-chan” , “The Aquatope on White Sand” , “BanG Dream! Movie: Episode of Roselia - Part II: Song I am” , and “Princess Principal Movie 1: Crown Handler” .
 Check out our list for “Top 10 Anime Of The Year” for 2021 below:
 
 10. Miss Kobayashi’s Dragon Maid S (Season 2)

 “Miss Kobayashi’s Dragon Maid S” Synopsis: The wacky Dragon Maid is back again! A strange turn of events leads the Dragon, Tohru, to work as Miss Kobayashi's maid. She occasionally (that's a lie, she often) causes trouble for her beloved Miss Kobayashi while blending into human society and splendidly (that's a lie, only mediocrely) carrying out her maid duties. Her fellow dragons, Kanna, Lucoa, Fafnir, and Elma all find their own places to fit in as well and enjoy interspecies interactions with the humans. Yet while they're all enjoying that laid-back and occasionally turbulent left, the threat of a new Dragon swoops down upon Miss Kobayashi.
 Where To Watch: Season 2 is currently streaming on Crunchyroll in subtitles and on Funimation in English dubbing. Season 1 and the “Mini Dragon” Short Anime series is also available on Crunchyroll in subtitles. Funimation is also currently streaming season 1 in English dubbing. 
 Episode Count: 12 episodes 

 9. Let’s Make A Mug Too Season 1 & 2

 “Let's Make a Mug Too” Synopsis: Together with her father, who had quit his salaryman job, Toyokawa Himeno moves to Gifu prefecture's Tajimi city. That's the city where her mother is from, whom she had lost when she was still young. Himeno is now attending her mother's alma mater, where her classmate Kukuri Mika invites her to tag along to a special place. That place turns out to be the pottery club! There, she learns for the first time that her mother was a legendary potter, and is consequently pulled into the world of pottery.
 Where To Watch: Seasons 1 and 2 are currently available to stream on Crunchyroll in subtitles. 
 Episode Count: Season 1 (12 episodes) and Season 2 (12 episodes)

 8. Selection Project

 “Selection Project” Synopsis: Suzune Miyama has been sick since childhood, but always used idol Akari Amasawa’s music for courage and smiles through hard times. Now in her final year of junior high, Suzune is auditioning against thousands of contestants to become one of nine chosen idols in the “Selection Project”—the exact audition competition Akari used to gain fame. Will she follow in her icon’s footsteps?
 Where To Watch: Funimation is currently streaming the series in subtitles. 
 Episode Count: 13 episodes 

 7. The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!

 “The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!” Synopsis: In the Dark Realm, the Great Jahy was only second to the demon king. Feared by all, she was supposed to be just enjoying being endlessly willful and hedonistic, when a magical girl attacked her and blasted her to the human realm. Forced to live in poverty, her days consist of working in a bar while living in a tiny apartment without a bathroom. Blowing both pity and the demand for rent away, her ambitions are grand: Restoring the Dark Realm!
 Where To Watch: Crunchyroll is currently streaming the series in subtitles. 
 Episode Count: 20 episodes 

 6. Blue Reflection Ray

 “Blue Reflection Ray” Synopsis: Optimistic Hiori can’t turn away anyone in need. Awkward Ruka can’t seem to make friends, even when she tries. But these two do have one thing in common: they’re both magical girls called Reflectors! Together, this unlikely pair will use their powers to help resolve emotional struggles and protect the Fragments of people’s hearts.
 Where To Watch: Funimation is currently streaming the series in subtitles. 
 Episode Count: 24 episodes

 5. Non Non Biyori Nonstop (Season 3)

 “Non Non Biyori Nonstop” Synopsis: Renge, Natsumi, Komari and former big-city-girl Hotaru live a quiet life in the Japanese countryside, but things get a lot more exciting when newcomer Akane Shinoda moves into the house next door to the Koshigaya family!
 Where To Watch: Season 3 is currently streaming on Crunchyroll and HIDIVE in subtitles. “Non Non Biyori” Season 1 and “Non Non Biyori Repeat” Season 2 are also available to stream on Crunchyroll in subtitles. Seasons 1, 2 and the film “Non Non Biyori Vacation” are also available to stream on HIDIVE.
 Episode Count: 12 episodes

 4. Love Live! Superstar!!

items.text:
The official “Yuki Yuna Is A Hero” website revealed five new characters for season 3. The new season, known as “Yuki Yuna is a Hero: The Great Mankai Chapter” (Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru: Dai Mankai no Shou), premiered on October 1, 2021 and is currently being simulcast on HIDIVE as part of their Fall 2021 Anime Lineup.

 Season 3 is confirmed to have 12 episodes based on the blu-ray release in Japan. The new cast and characters, which will be introduced in season 3 episode 2, include: 
 Minami Tanaka as “Kusunoki Mebuki”, a strong and serious girl. Because of her hard-working and unyielding personality, she does everything.

 Yuko Ono as “Kokudo Aya”, a shrine maiden in the first grade of junior high school who grew up in a house of devout Shinki faith. She has a very pure personality and is a refreshing agent for the team of buds.

 Atsumi Tanezaki as “Kagajo Suzume”, a second year junior high school student who is not confident in herself. She has a negative personality and is reluctant to move forward, and is left to defend in battle.

 Naomi Ohzora as “Miroku Yukaiko”, a third-year junior high school student who has a high pride and wants to stand out. Her spirit of achievement is stronger than anyone else, but she is a little stubborn.

 Shizuka Ishigami as “Yamabuki Shizuku”, a second-year junior high school student who grew up in a complicated family environment and has few words. A child who is very hard to read what she is thinking.

 Sentai Filmworks recently announced the acquisition of the streaming and home video rights to “Yuki Yuna is a Hero” franchise including seasons 1, 2 and 3 as well as “Yuki Yuna is a Hero: Churutto!”, a collection of shorts set in the universe of the main series. 
 Season 3 Synopsis: The magical girls of the Sanshu Middle School Hero Club have one goal: to make people smile whenever they can and to always help those in need. Through teamwork and the help of their magical powers, Yuna, Mimori, Fuu, Itsuki, Karin and Sonoko have vanquished deadly Vertexes, recovered a missing friend and balanced their lives as magical girls and regular middle school students. Now a new adventure begins, one that will test their skills and their bond as friends alike.

 The new anime season, known in Japan as “Yuki Yuna Is A Hero: Great Full Blossom Chapter” (Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru: Dai Mankai no Shou), was announced in August 2020 on the 6th anniversary of the franchise and is a direct sequel to “Yuki Yuna Is A Hero: The Hero Chapter”. 
 The original staff and voice cast returned with Studio Gokumi handling the animation. The series stars Haruka Terui as “Yuna Yuki”, Suzuko Mimori as “Mimori Togo”, Yumi Uchiyama as “Fu Inubozaki”, Tomoyo Kurosawa as “Itsuki Inubozaki”, Juri Nagatsuma as “Karin Miyoshi” and Kana Hanazawa as “Nogi Sonoko”.

 The first season originally premiered in 2014 with 12 episodes and can currently be streamed on Crunchyroll . The second season, which premiered in 2017, was split between a 6-episode prequel, “Yuki Yuna Is A Hero: The Washio Sumi Chapter”, and a 6-episode sequel, “Yuki Yuna Is A Hero: The Hero Chapter”. Recently, “Yuki Yuna Is A Hero Churutto!” short anime series premiered in Japan. In addition to the anime, the franchise includes manga, light novels and video games.

items.title: Yuri Visual Novel Spotlight: "Lilja and Natsuka: Painting Lies"
items.text:
Welcome to our “Yuri Spotlight” series! As part of our mission to spread the word about all things Yuri and help grow the Yuri community, we will be highlighting past and current Visual Novel releases. Check out "Lilja and Natsuka: Painting Lies"!

 Tokyo-based game developer Frontwing and Bushiroad released "Lilja and Natsuka: Painting Lies" for Steam on July 25, 2024.

 The sapphic visual game is described as a “heartwarming story of Lilja, a blind painter, and Natsuka, her energetic assistant, who unravel the mysteries behind their clients' requests”.

 The single-player game features a kinetic story with no choices or branches. The story is available with Japanese, English, and Simplified Chinese text options in both single and dual-language display modes. The planning and story was handled by Asou Ei with character design by Kippu.

 “Lilja and Natsuka: Painting Lies” is a fully voiced in Japanese and stars Tomoyo Takayanagi as “Lilja Meri” and Yurie Igoma as “Utsugi Natsuka”.

 Additional voice cast includes: Minami Tanaka, Takako Tanaka, Rumi Okubo, Aoi Koga, Nene Hieda, Sayuri Hara, Mika Kanda, Yoshino Aoyama, and Ikumi Hasegawa.

 The game’s opening theme, “The Stories of Tomorrow” (below), is sung by yanaginagi. The ending song, "Colors of You", is performed by Hina Aoki.

 Story Synopsis: The world is illuminated by your light, and the flowers you hold give it color.
 There's a rumor spreading quietly across the internet: "An anonymous painter will paint anything you request."

 They do not want money or fame. Capricious and eccentric, the painter only accepts requests that pique their interest. Those lucky enough to meet this mysterious criteria will be chosen to meet with Lilja—a beautiful girl with long, fairy-like silver hair and eyes that shine like gemstones. Even though she is blind and wheelchair-bound, this does not hinder her genius.

 "From this day forward, I'm going to become your new eyes and legs!"
 Natsuka is her energetic live-in assistant. She acts as Lilja's eyes and legs, using her instinct and intuition to find the inspiration and information beyond what's necessary that Lilja seeks.

 "I don't know for sure, but I can feel it!"
 Her words resound within Lilja and become the "light" that illuminates her world. The blue of reminiscence, the green of monsters, the red of martyrdom...
 "My little dove has brought me an olive leaf! It's now my turn to take care of the rest." 
 The results far exceed the clients' wildest dreams. "The world seen through your eyes is much more beautiful than the world I used to see." Tortured by their pasts, two girls walk into a new future in this story of loss and rebirth.

 “Lilja and Natsuka: Painting Lies” is available to purchase on Steam for $22.99.

items.title: Game Developer YuriEureka Announces Yuri Visual Novel “Kiss the Demiurge”
items.text:
Indie game developer and publisher YuriEureka announced their first Yuri visual novel “Kiss the Demiurge”. The dark comedy VN is set to be released in Fall 2022. 

 YuriEureka describes the visual novel as "darkly comedic" and the game will “explore themes of love, repression and the nature of truth”. “Kiss the Demiurge” is currently available to add to your wish list on Steam . 

 The single-player game features three routes and approximately 15 hours of reading in English subtitles with a Mature Content warning. 

 Story Synopsis: “Minori is a mage who hates magic. She views it as a chaotic force of nature that can only bring destruction and has dedicated her life to hiding it from the world. She has spurned friendship, family, and even love in pursuit of this goal. Minori doesn't even view herself as a human being. Nothing more than a machine with the single goal of purifying the world and humanity of magic.

 Minori investigates a fire at a local high school that she suspects to have been caused by magic. There, she just so happens to spy a poster advertising a magic club, dedicated to "Studying and spreading magic across the world."

 The very sight of the poster makes Minori's blood boil. She immediately transfers schools so that she can infiltrate and investigate the club. There she meets Akane, Chitori, and Tomoko. Three delusional girls obsessed with magic. Fortunately for Minori, none of them understand how magic truly works. And it's Minori's job to make sure it stays that way. 

 Will Minori be able to destroy the club before they learn about true magic? Or will Minori be charmed by the club members, and let down her heart's guard?”

 The characters include: 
 “Minori” works tirelessly to keep the world safe from magic. She considers herself to be a machine whose personal feelings are irrelevant. But even the stoic Minori has a sensitive side. She feels great attraction towards other girls, which she views as a distraction. But how long will she be able to suppress those feelings for?

 “Akane” is the self-proclaimed leader of the club. She claims that she's descended from an ancient line of magical samurai and will proudly boast of this heritage to anyone who'll listen. She's certain that one day the world will understand her genius, and give her family the respect they deserve.

 “Chitori” is a shy fortune teller. She would like for nothing more than the world to leave her alone with her books. Whether it's tarot cards, astrology, or a crystal ball, she'll use whatever she can to predict the future and avoid any unwanted surprises.

 The elegant and beautiful “Tomoko” claims to be a spirit medium who regularly speaks to the spirits of the dead. She's always eager to help people connect with the spirits of deceased friends and family. Perhaps a little bit too eager...

 “Kiss the Demiurge” will be available for Windows, MacOS and Linux on Steam and is set to be released in Fall 2022.

items.title: Noodletub Games Launches Kickstarter For Yuri Visual Novel “Good Luck Baby!”
items.text:
Game developer and publisher Noodletub Games announced this week that they have launched a Kickstarter campaign for their next yuri visual novel “Good Luck Baby!”.

 Noodletub Games is an indie team comprised of two queer women and their focus is on creating yuri story driven games. They previously released the yuri visual novel “LOVE BAKUDAN” back in January 2021. The “Good Luck Baby!” Kickstarter campaign reached its full funding goal within 24 hours but is still active in order to secure additional funding for the “stretch goals” that include extra scenes and a villain route.

 Set in 2002 Japan, “Good Luck Baby!” is a kinetic yuri visual novel about true love, found family, and happiness blooming in unexpected circumstances. Inspiration for the game came directly from the creators and they went on to elaborate that, “As two lesbians, we wanted to follow our hearts and make games that really appealed to our own tastes. We wanted to explore not just romantic love between women, but also the safety and comfort that often comes with the subject of found family. We wanted to create something that was not just heartwarming, but also interesting in a way that allows people of all ages and walks of life to see that there is a world waiting for them with open arms, too. It means so much to us to be able to share our stories with the world, and we hope everyone gets as much joy out of experiencing them as we do creating them.”

 Story Synopsis: Having a stroke of bad luck sucks . Having a few weeks of bad luck is even worse . That's something Hifumi Tanaka unfortunately learns first-hand. Stubbing her toe one too many times, losing her wallet on the train to the city, getting to school two hours late... this unrelenting streak of misfortune makes her cry out in frustration to the universe. “Can't something good happen for once?!”
 Hifumi's luck begins to turn around upon meeting the famous delinquent Kasumi Itou. Even though she's known at school for being trouble, the reality is that Kasumi is a funny, level-headed girl with a heart of gold. Just as their mutual crushes on each other begin to bloom, they are met with one heck of a surprise...
 A baby with a halo sitting happily on Kasumi's doorstep! 
 Meeting this baby changes not just the lives and luck of our girls, but the entire world - and maybe even the galaxy - as we know it. Can they evade the looming shadow of a mysterious villain known only as "Empress Metis" long enough to get this baby back home? 

 “Good Luck Baby!” will be officially released for PC on Steam and itch.io in Winter 2022. For more information or to pledge funding to the project, check out the Kickstarter website .

items.title: Yuri Visual Novel Spotlight: “Salome's Kiss”
items.text:
Welcome to our “Yuri Spotlight” series! As part of our mission to spread the word about all things Yuri and help grow the Yuri community, we will be highlighting past and current Visual Novel releases. Check out “Salome's Kiss”!

 Game developer and publisher ebi-hime released “Salome's Kiss” on Steam and itch.io for Windows and Linux on April 26, 2022.

 The single-player game is described as “A lesbian gothic romance tale set in Victorian England, in which an anxious governess is aggressively pursued by her unruly, tempestuous pupil.”

 The single-player game features a kinetic story with no choices or branches. The dramatic gothic romance story is about 120k words of text or approximately 4-8 hours of reading with detailed character and background artwork. The story is written by ebi-hime, the author of the Yuri visual novel “Blackberry Honey” . The story is available in subtitles in English and Simplified Chinese.

 In addition, you can download for free the “Adult Patch”. The 18+ patch adds three uncensored lesbian sex scenes in the story, which are scattered through the story.

 Story Synopsis: Letitia Reed is an unremarkable woman in many aspects. Meek and mild, she prefers to keep her head down, and fears drawing undue attention to herself. As a governess to the wealthy Mortimer family, Letitia devotes her humdrum days in London to the schooling of her pupil, Clara, to better mould her into the image of an ideal lady.

Lurking beneath Letitia’s placid mannerisms, however, lay desires so intense they begin to unnerve her. As Clara matures, Letitia finds her feelings towards her maturing too – until, in the end, she can no longer bear it.

 Driven to distraction by Clara’s sensuous brown eyes and her sweet, seraphic laughter, Letitia soon begins to question her sanity. Fearful that, eventually, something within her might snap, and she will do something she regrets, Letitia is bidden to leave her former place of employment, and to seek out work elsewhere.

Fortunately, Letitia soon discovers, in the pages of The Morning Post, a job offer which will grant her a means to escape her predicament. The Langley family are searching for a governess for their daughter, the unruly Genevieve – and, best of all, the family resides in the isolated Yorkshire moors, which seems as far away from London as it is possible to get.

 Upon reading this advertisement, Letitia soon decides to hand in her notice. She will travel to Yorkshire, become Genevieve’s governess, and then – God willing – she will be able to forget about Clara.

Such was Letitia’s plan – but this plan, alas, soon goes horribly awry. Genevieve is not quite so young as Letitia first believed, and is, instead, a grown woman: already eighteen years of age. Genevieve is wilful and impetuous, but impossibly charming, and Letitia soon falls for her.

As time passes, the two women get far closer than a governess and her pupil ought, and then…

 “Salome's Kiss” is available to purchase on Steam and itch.io for $12.99.

 Indie developer Prof. Lily released the demo for “I Became Gay from Translating My New Roommate's Short Story” aka “GFT” on November 16, 2021 on itch.io for Windows and macOS. The Yuri visual novel game is set to be released in 2022. 

 The 18+ single-player game is described as “a Yuri visual novel about two "working" adults in the city of Chicago. Through the peculiar relationship between an exhausted translator and a writer under severe creative aporia, this women-loving-women visual novel explores issues of art and social media under late capitalism. It is the first major project by the Prof. Lily visual novel collective, who aim to tell stories that face our harsh subcultural reality head-on.”

 The game currently features text in English with a five chapter script spanning over a 50k word count and original illustrations. The VN also includes a customizable warnings feature for in-game sensitive content (Pictured above.) and will depict mature content including sex.

 Synopsis: How do people create art under late capitalism without becoming fed up and burnt out? That is the question shared by Fiona Watanabe and Junko Takeda as they become roommates in the city of Chicago. Fiona, a Chicago denizen since her teens, is a competent but exhausted translator working on Japanese media she admittedly doesn't like. Meanwhile, Junko is stretching the definition of what an "up-and-coming" writer can be. These two unlikely protagonists see in each other their ideal selves, but do not recognize the other is still unsatisfied. They can only stumble through the worlds of translation and art towards blurry and barely-defined goals, enveloped in this late capitalist hell.

 The characters include:
 Fiona Watanabe - "I'm hanging up if this is gonna turn into another matchmaking session." 
 An eccentric translator, Fiona first became part of the translating scene through fan translation. Her years of experience in agency work have left her feeling jaded about the future of Japanese media and she seems to be beginning to lose hope until she meets Junko, her new roommate. Will this meeting change the direction of her life?

 Junko Takeda - "Reading famous English authors only makes me feel embarrassed about my own writing. I find them to be too powerful...” 
 An emerging writer who has fallen deep into the depths of writer's block, Junko was sent to Chicago to room with Fiona for university. She wishes she was as hard-working and competent as Fiona. Perhaps, this breath of fresh Chicago air could do something for her...

items.title: Yuri Visual Novel Spotlight: “SeaBed”
items.text:
Welcome to our “Yuri Spotlight” series! As part of our mission to spread the word about all things Yuri and help grow the Yuri community, we will be highlighting past Visual Novel releases. Check out “SeaBed”!

 Developer Paleontology and publisher Fruitbat Factory released “SeaBed” back in December 2017 on Steam . The Yuri visual novel was later released on Nintendo Switch in March 2020. 

 The single player game is described as “a yuri-themed mystery visual novel told through the perspectives of three separate characters: Sachiko, Takako and Narasaki.”

 The game features interfaces and subtitles in both English and Japanese. 

 Story Synopsis: SeaBed is a critically acclaimed yuri-themed mystery visual novel told through the perspectives of three separate characters: Mizuno Sachiko, a designer plagued by hallucinations of her past lover; Narasaki Hibiki, Sachiko's friend and a psychiatrist researching the workings of human memories; and Takako, Sachiko's former lover who has been rapidly forgetting her past, including how or why the two women drifted apart despite being together since childhood. All three live in different worlds, but seek the same goal. To separate truth from illusion. To make sense of their own lives.

 The main characters include: 

 Mizuno Sachiko 
 "At times, I'd wake up at night and hear all the sounds around me as if they were amplified. I'd feel like my head could burst at any second." 

Although she moved to Tokyo straight after graduating university in order to seek employment, Mizuno Sachiko soon quit her job to establish Clover Design with her childhood friend Takako, becoming its young CEO. 

Her main hobby is reading, but only because nothing else manages to interest her. Although Sachiko used to be quite an avid reader during her school years, finding a job means she now only opens a book every once in a while, whenever her schedule allows it. 

After meeting Takako – an inexhaustible source of enthusiasm, as well as a stark contrast to her own personality – during her childhood years, Sachiko’s interests began to shift to whatever the other woman was doing at a given time.

 Takako 
 "This is as good a time as any, so let's check it out."

Endlessly interested in and enthusiastic about the world, Takako gives the impression of a woman perpetually stuck in her childhood.

She fell in love with Sachiko at first sight back when they first met at the age of five. However, she does not identify as a homosexual, stressing that Sachiko simply happened to be a woman.

Takako discovers that she suffers from developmental amnesia, a condition that severely impairs her ability to recall many of her memories

 Narasaki Hibiki 
 "I just like observing people." 

A psychiatrist at Narasaki Mental Clinic. She was Sachiko's classmate and friend during her elementary school years, but the two drifted apart as they enrolled in different middle schools. After learning that Sachiko has been experiencing hallucinations, she takes it upon herself to treat her. 

She is extremely picky about her brand of coffee, perhaps because the beverage serves as her sole companion during those long hours spent immersed in research. 

Though not religious, she is a strong believer that everything happens for a reason, and all things have their place and order in the grand scheme of the world.

 “SeaBed” is available to purchase on Steam and Nintendo Switch for $19.99.

Advanced, more efficient and remarkably perceptive, unit M.A.R.A. begins to penetrate Cila's toughened exterior and possibly even heal her new owner's old wounds – if Cila can decipher the recurring nightmare the process brings. Soon Cila and Mara forge a unique - if sometimes uneasy - bond. Unbeknownst to Cila, just as her life begins to find its new normal, the technological giant Velta Labs gets wind of Mara's existence and takes a mysterious interest in the android. A war unlike any before it is brewing on the horizon, its players are silently being selected and one android's fate may spell the difference between peace, war, the blossoming of a new religion, or a technological singularity beyond comprehension.

 The single role-playing game features multiple endings with “choices that deeply affect the protagonist's journey and world around them” and is an estimated 6-9 hours of gameplay.

items.title: “Blue Reflection: Second Light” Game To Be Released November 2021
items.text:
Publisher KOEI Tecmo and developer Gust recently announced that “Blue Reflection: Second Light” will be released on November 9, 2021 in North America and Europe. The game will be available on PC via Steam, PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch.

 The new game, known in Japan as “Blue Reflection: Tie”, will be a sequel to 2017’s “Blue Reflection” and was previously announced to be released in Japan on October 21, 2021 for Playstation 4 and Nintendo Switch. 

 Synopsis: “BLUE REFLECTION: Second Light” follows the adventures of three students – Ao Hoshizaki, Kokoro Utsubo, and Yuki Kinjou – who find themselves transported to a mysterious floating academy, searching for clues to find their way back home, with only their names as memories. One day, a path leading to a new land appears, but when the three protagonists set off to unravel the mystery, they’re met by a series of deadly monsters. By battling the fiendish creatures, they unlock unknown powers that only seem to deepen the cryptic nature of their surroundings. 

 Throughout the adventure, the three friends cooperate and struggle to make their everyday-life as rich and as fun as possible. While spending every day trapped in this unknown world, the characters’ true feelings and personalities will be revealed, and as their bonds grow deeper, they will acquire new strengths and abilities. Furthermore, not only will the protagonists be able to build their ideal academy throughout the game, but they will also be able to craft items together, and depending on the character combinations, the completed item’s properties can change, even triggering special conversations. By deepening their friendships, the three students will eventually grow closer to the mystery of this world and the reason of why they lost their memories.

 In addition to the Western release date, it was announced that the character “Hiori Hirahara”, voiced by Manaka Iwami, will appear in the new game. “Hiori Hirahara” is a main characters of the TV anime “Blue Reflection Ray”, and will be one of the key characters that ties together the stories of the anime and game. 
 “Blue Reflection Ray” is currently being simulcast in the US by Funimation as it airs in Japan. The TV anime is set to run for two cours or half a year. 

 NIS America also announced a Limited Edition version of “Blue Reflection: Second Light” that is available to pre-order for the PS4 and Nintendo Switch. The package includes exclusive cloth poster, academy notebook-styled photo album, art book, 2 acrylic mini character charms, “Special Costume for Ao: Ryza Style” download code, and a North American Collector’s Box.

 The franchise previously announced a third game entitled “Blue Reflection: Sun” that will launch for smartphones and PC in the next year.

items.title: Yuri Visual Novel “Symbiotic Love” Released On Steam
items.text:
Video game publisher Kikai Digital recently released the yuri visual novel “Symbiotic Love” on Steam . 

 From Chinese game developer White Dew Games, “Symbiotic Love” is a prequel to the yuri visual novel “Melancholy Love”, which was released in January 2021 in English and is also currently available on Steam . Both are a part of the four-game Linghua Yuri Series.

 The VN features voice acting in Mandarin with subtitles in English. The game developer describes the series as an “emotional yuri love story with mystery elements” and features five different endings based on the player’s choices during the game. 

 Synopsis: There's nothing new under the sun. All stories go like this: Encounter. Curiosity. Attraction. Love. Two girls meet in a garden where the spider lilies bloom. One girl seeks the devil's gentleness. The other denies that the devil is capable of love at all. Will the spider lilies grow in a symbiotic relationship, or will they become like the higanbana, and part ways for good?

 Symbiotic Love is a coming-of-age Yuri Visual Novel set in an All Girls' High School, between two people fated to meet, become acquainted, friends, and eventually, lovers. Yet, what has fate in store for love so perfect, so symbiotic, that they could only live, and perish together?

items.title: Yuri Mini Review: “The Fed-Up Office Lady Wants to Serve the Villainess” Manga
items.text:
Introducing our “Yuri Mini Reviews”! As part of our mission to spread the word about all things Yuri, we will be doing quick reviews that highlight the work and give our take on the material but don’t take a lot of time to read. We know you would rather spend more quality time actually reading Yuri but also know it can hard to find what to read next, so we are here to help!

 Manga: “The Fed-Up Office Lady Wants to Serve the Villainess” 
 Volumes: 1-4
 Publisher: Seven Seas Entertainment
 Author & Artist: Nekotarou
 Available to read: BookWalker website and app. (Review copies courtesy of BookWalker.)

 Publisher Synopsis: Natori Midori has been giving it all at her hum-drum office job for three years now, only to have the rug pulled out from under her when she's suddenly laid off. But just as she's feeling lost and adrift, she is summoned to the world of the visual novel she's currently playing, Fairy Tale of Jewels. And the person who summoned her there? None other than the game's cruel villainess, Lapis Tenebrau, who's trying to take down the main cast of the game. Driven into a corner, Natori pretends she's psychic and uses her knowledge of the game to save Lapis from danger. Now Lapis has taken a shine to her, and is going to make Natori her private secretary?! Can Natori handle this new job, and her growing feelings for her villainess boss?

 Spoiler Free Mini Review: We had the chance to read the first 4 volumes of this series and we are hooked. This Yuri manga offers another take on the classic genre of being reincarnated into a game. Even though the storyline is a common theme, we felt that, unlike other stories, this manga stays more on the serious side rather than the usual cliché comedy scenes or plot points. 
 The story is anchored by the character Natori, who is driven by her pure natural of wanting to help and please those around her, and the “villainess” Lapis, who is cold-hearted and determined to destroy those who have wronged her. Their love story is a slow burn, and it has a natural progressive feel throughout the volumes. It’s not “love at first sight”, and that actually made the story make more sense. 
 We also liked the love triangle between Natori and Lapis with the game’s protagonist, Diana. In other stories, love triangles are usually annoying and the reader tends to want to just stay focused on the main couple. But Diana is a likable character that grows from the stereotypical “hero” to a complicated and interesting character. 
 Overall, we loved the art design of characters and how the outfit details added to the imagination of the game world. The lore of the magic in the story is also easy to follow. Certain stories often get too complicated or tend to spend too much time explaining the world of the game, but this story keeps it simple. The story gives enough to create the world but not to bore you with the details. We were also impressed by the dialogue in a lot of the scenes. Sometimes scenes suffer because of weak writing but we felt that the dialogue stayed strong throughout. 
 Volume 3 was our favorite volume so far. In that volume, you especially start to see the progression between the character’s feelings, and at the same time, the danger and issues of the game’s world, start become more evident. 
 We are looking forward to reading Volume 5 , which is set to be released on December 22, 2026 by Seven Seas, and will also be available to read on BookWalker .

 Manga: “Lilies Blooming in 100 Days”

 Publisher Synopsis: This beautifully illustrated, full-color collection of comics features one hundred different Yuri scenes! Packed full of high school, adult, and age-gap couples in cute, funny, and spicy scenarios, this book contains plenty of unique pairings to enjoy. Watch as romance blossoms in classrooms and bedrooms alike!

 Spoiler Free Mini Review: This Girls Love anthology manga is a nice easy read with all your favorite types of Yuri stories. The short stories are literally broken into “100 Days” with Yuri scenarios like: “Aquarium Date”, “Office Lady Senpai and Kouhai”, “Honors Student x Trendy Girl”, and “Fresh-Start College Student x Party Girl”.
 Our favorites were the adult relationships, especially the office romances. Certain stories left us wanting more, and we kelp wishing the author would have expanded certain stories into long form manga.
 Overall, we were impressed by the beautiful art style. The whole volume is in full color and the author and artist, Muromaki, did such a great job paying attention to the simple details like the characters clothing. Those simple details truly add to the enjoyment of the story for the reader. For Yuri lovers who want a quick fun read and don’t want to settle for one type of Yuri story, this manga is perfect for you.
 We look forward to the sequel, “Lilies in Love for 101 Days” , that will be released by Yen Press next year and available on BookWalker .

items.text:
Introducing our “Yuri Mini Reviews”! As part of our mission to spread the word about all things Yuri, we will be doing quick reviews that highlight the work and give our take on the material but don’t take a lot of time to read. We know you would rather spend more quality time actually reading Yuri but also know it can hard to find what to read next, so we are here to help! 

 Webcomic: “Opium”
 Created By: Junghyun and Aji.
 Available To Read: Tapas Media App or Tapas Website .
 Rating: Mature (Content warning - explicit sex)

 Tapas Synopsis: 1946 Choseon (Korea). Beautiful and brilliant Dr. Maria Arden returns to the country of her birth as the medical advisor to the U.S. Army—a stranger in an unfamiliar land ravaged by wars and corruption. There, she meets Dr. Kyeongju Lee, an alluring, mysterious woman shunned by society. Their innocent flirtations turn into a heated, forbidden love affair, as an illegal trade in opium threatens Choseon’s fragile stability. Two outsiders drawn helplessly to each other, but… everything was a lie. 

 Spoiler Free Mini Review: Honestly, one of the best webcomic’s we have ever read. The art, the writing, everything was amazing from beginning to end. We have read a lot of Yuri/GL, and sometimes we forget what it is to experience an amazing story that is above the rest and feels new. “Opium” is that story. 
 Like some, we initially wrote off the webcomic due to its cover art being so explicit and figured it was little plot with lots of sex scenes. Don’t get us wrong, sometimes we are in the mood for that. But to our pleasant surprise, this was an original historical story, that you could tell after a few chapters, the writer had done research into what women had to face as doctors and in society during that time period. Without giving any details away, the actual romance between the two female leads is well done and believable. We dare you not to fall in love with Maria. 
 Overall, “Opium” had an interesting plot with action, lots of fun lewd scenes, and ultimately gave you a wonderful romance between two adult women that had you hooked until the end.
